details: CIP Safety Multi-Point Target & Originator Engine (W214) verified cleanly (9/9 stages passed).

standards: ODVA CIP Networks Library Volume 5 (CIP Safety)

stages.details: Pure IEC 61131-3 ST validated; all 10 registers bound; ladder constructs intercepted.
SNN formatting/parsing, TUNID/OUNID matching, and rogue SNN signature rejection verified.
Channel A / Channel B complement verified; bit-flip discrepancy triggered 0xE602 fault.
CRC-S1 and inverted CRC-S2 verified; single-bit CRC corruption caused 0xE603 fault.
EPI watchdog silence monitored; 60.0 ms expiration tripped 0xE601 into SAFE_STATE.
Ping-pong round-trip measured; mean/max latencies calculated and scaled x10 ms.
Monotonic 16-bit sequence progression verified; replayed sequence number 11 rejected.
8 concurrent safety connections provisioned across Originator/Target; HEALTHY, DEGRADED, and FAULTED states confirmed.
Horner OCS %R1750..%R1757 and %M408..%M409 synced; 0xE603 trip and operator reset verified.
